ItemID: NA; Title: M3-0.5 x 12mm (100 PCS) Socket Head Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 12.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Coarse Thread UNC, DIN 912; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Small metric fasteners fit my projects, but I would check my existing assortment and the thread specification before choosing these.
ItemID: NA; Title: KEYXE 8Pcs Screw Eyes, 3.2 Inch Black Eye Hooks Screw Self Tapping Eye, Heavy Duty Eye Bolt for Wood Securing Cables Wire, Hammock Stand, Indoor & Outdoor Use; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have an immediate cable securing or hanging task that needs large screw eyes.
ItemID: NA; Title: PLA 3D Printer Filament Bundle, TINMORRY PLA Filament 1.75mm, 250g x 5 Spools, Black+White+Blue+Red+Green, Net Weight 1.25kg; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent work centers on fastening and fabrication supplies; I have no current need for printing filament.
ItemID: NA; Title: #6 x 1" Flat Head Self Drilling Screws, 410 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Countersunk Head Self Drilling Screws with Self Tapping Screw Thread, 100 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These could suit sheet metal work, but I would choose the broader screw assortment on this page first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current pressure measurement task requiring this range and fitting.
ItemID: NA; Title: FOLIV 265PCS Black Self Tapping Screws, 8 x 1/2” to 1-1/2” (410) Stainless Steel Modified Truss Head Sheet Metal Screws Assortment Kit, Black Oxide Self Drilling, 6 Different Length Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Multiple lengths would be useful for repair and assembly work, consistent with my repeated purchases of fastener assortments.
ItemID: NA; Title: 100 Nitrile Exam Gloves 3.5 Mil - Latex & Powder Free, Disposable Non-Sterile Protective Gloves By PlastCare; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Disposable gloves could help with messy projects, but I would verify their suitability for my epoxy materials before buying.
ItemID: NA; Title: TECSONAR Tricolor PLA Filament Coextrusion Filament 1kg Triple Color Filament 1.75mm (± 0.03 mm) Compatible w/Most of 3D Printer Silk Gold Silver Copper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Decorative printing material does not address any current project reflected in my recent purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: toolant Four Sprial Flute Step Drill Bit, 1/8"-7/8"(3pcs) Impact Ready Titanium Coated Unibit Step Bit, 1/4" Hex Shank Unibit for Metal, Stainless Steel, Aluminum, Wood, Plastic; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Step bits would complement my drill set and help make different hole sizes for rivets and threaded inserts in sheet material.
ItemID: NA; Title: M5-0.8 x 45mm (50 pcs) Hexagon Socket Head Cap Screws, Furniture Screws, Connecting Bolts, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Full Thread, Bright Finish, Metric Standard; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Metric socket screws fit my interests, but I would wait until a project specifically needs the 45mm length.
